mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 enzymes, potentially increasing phenytoin metabolism and reducing serum levels, while curcumin's anticoagulant properties may increase bleeding risk.
action: Monitor phenytoin serum levels closely; consider increased phenytoin dosing if turmeric supplementation is initiated; counsel on bleeding precautions and coordinate with provider before concurrent use.
